Workflow.Entry: My characters | My clothes | Downloads | Create | Settings
Workflow.Player: Downloads -> Subscribe -> matching wearer -> My characters -> Choose an outfit -> Play
Workflow.Texture: My characters -> player -> Edit this game character (stock) or Customize (custom) -> Edit textures -> item -> Export model & textures -> Artwork -> Import texture set -> Build & launch game
Workflow.Clothing: My clothes -> garment -> body fit -> Prepare once -> Edit & save same Blender file -> Build & launch game -> Looks good in game. Existing fitted files can be chosen directly; artwork tools are optional.
Workflow.Character: Create -> Make a character -> fresh unique MetaHuman source -> edit in Creator -> adapt/import Body and Face to native game rig -> Build & launch game -> Check in game. Skin maps alone cannot activate a new avatar.
Workflow.StockEditing: My characters -> Tyreese, DeShawn or Darnell -> Edit this game character -> textures or meshes. Stock player identity is retained.
Workflow.Fitting: Green reference bodies and separate native rigs share one working scene. Each supported body needs its own fitted, weighted variant; shared MetaHuman bone names do not automatically fit clothes.
Workflow.Library: Three stock players plus genuinely installed custom avatars. My clothes includes authored projects, subscribed downloads and sealed character wardrobe garments. Same-name saved versions group by wearer and slot; choose latest or earlier versions without deleting sources.
Workflow.Portraits: Model illustrations rather than UV maps. Offline cards do not reproduce unavailable hair grooms, iris shading or native game lighting.
Workflow.NextAction: One primary action per stage. Changed Blender saves or artwork invalidate old build and game confirmations.
Workflow.MissingTextureRecovery: Same item -> Artwork -> Import PNG or Import texture set. Preserve original maps and packed Mask layout.
Workflow.Wardrobe: Wearer -> category -> compatible clothing -> Play with outfit. Texture edits and clothing changes do not require a new character.
